notes: An error wrapped in a one-element JSON array, the framing streamGenerateContent uses without alt=sse; googleapis/python-genai google/genai/errors.py (APIError.__init__) unwraps exactly this. Whether the alt=sse endpoint the gateway calls ever answers so is unverified; the inventory's probe found it becomes a 502. The error body is google.rpc.Status in its HTTP JSON mapping ({"error": {code, message, status, details}}); status names and their HTTP codes come from googleapis google/rpc/code.proto, details from google/rpc/error_details.proto and google/api/error_reason.proto (read 2026-10-28).

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap G21: parseGeminiError decodes only a bare {"error": ...} object; an array-wrapped body falls through to a 502 whose message is the raw body, so a rate limit is retried at once and fails over
known gap G19: error.details, RetryInfo included, are dropped
